description: Defines data structures and functions related to Type0-PDCCH CSS monitoring occasions for pattern 1 in 5G NR, including configuration parameters, occasion description, and helper functions for slot calculations.

classes.name: pdcch_type0_css_occasion_pattern1_description
classes.description: Describes a Type0-PDCCH CSS monitoring occasion for pattern 1, including parameters for offset, M, and start symbols.

methods.name: pdcch_type0_css_occasions_get_pattern1
methods.description: Retrieves Type0-PDCCH CSS occasions for multiplexing pattern 1 based on provided configuration.

methods.name: type0_pdcch_css_n0_is_even_frame
methods.description: Determines if slot n0 is in an even or odd frame based on given parameters.

methods.name: get_type0_pdcch_css_n0
methods.description: Calculates the slot n0 where UE should monitor Type0-PDCCH CSS for a given SSB index.
